prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1005; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed first notice of loss for left-turn collision at intersection. Insured reports other vehicle struck rear quarter panel while insured was completing a left turn. Police report number pending. Scheduled recorded statement with insured.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from insured. Insured states oncoming vehicle was approaching at speed and did not yield. Photos of both vehicles uploaded to file. No visible airbag deployment on insured vehicle. Requested traffic signal timing records for the intersection.

Entry 3: Contacted claimant, who is not represented by counsel. Claimant reports neck and lower back pain following the impact and has an appointment with a primary care provider. Explained the claims process and the right to obtain medical records and estimates. Requested authorization to access treatment records.

Entry 4: Received repair estimate for insured vehicle from the designated shop. Estimate reviewed and found consistent with damage pattern in photos. Supplement requested for hidden damage to rear suspension. Reserve adjusted to reflect current liability assessment and injury claim.

Entry 5: Follow-up with claimant regarding treatment progress. Claimant reports back strain diagnosed, prescribed physical therapy, and is currently off work for limited duty. Provided written summary of coverage for bodily injury and reminded claimant that medical documentation should be forwarded as received. Liability review remains open pending police report and signal records.
